Site Reliability Engineer

Our platform team keeps a multi-region SaaS product fast and available. You will own our
Kubernetes clusters and the tooling around them.

You have at least 5 years of experience operating production infrastructure, and you have run
Kubernetes in production. You write infrastructure as code with Terraform and automate with
Python or Go. You know Linux well and have built monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana.

It would be great if you have used Helm and Argo CD, or hold a CKA certification.
